title: Guided lattice quickstart: micro-tile checklist, empty-state screenshots & tip anchors
creator: Maya Singh
description: Design ticket to produce a compact, tile-first onboarding surface ("lattice") for the Console first-run experience. Deliverables: micro-tile checklist artboards for light/dark, three responsive screenshot variants per major route, annotated empty-state illustrations, contextual tip anchors that persist during the first session, and an asset export bundle for engineering (SVG, PNG @1x/@2x, JSON hint file with positions). Goal is to replace the existing long modal checklist with bite-sized tiles that reduce time-to-first-success and improve discoverability of Console features (projects, models, deployments, API keys).
background: PM research (see linked Confluence brief) showed new users are overwhelmed by long modal lists; analytics show 32% drop-off on route 'Create first model endpoint' during onboarding. This lattice micro-tile approach groups actions into 6 high-impact tiles and surfaces inline tips after the first successful action. The visual language should feel lightweight, use existing illustration system but with new 'progress halo' micro-animations (motion spec attached).
deliverables: 6 tile artboards (light + dark) - desktop UI mockups
Tip-anchor design system components and placement map
Export bundle: SVG, PNG @1x @2x, JSON layout hints
Handoff spec document and CSS tokens mapping
export_specs: SVGs: optimized, remove editor metadata, preserve IDs
PNGs: @1x 1x, @2x 2x, width constrained to breakpoint sizes
Typography: use Inter variable, fallback stack exported
Animation: Lottie demo JSON and CSS motion spec (50-300ms)
interactions: Tile press: immediate colored outline + micro-halo animation, then route to action
Complete tile: subtle check morph to badge and progress counter + confetti token (small)
Tip anchors: anchored to route header; dismissible with 'don't show again' persisted in local storage
Empty-states: CTA button + secondary 'learn more' link to docs; graphic animates on hover for desktop
accessibility_considerations: All tiles keyboard-focusable with visible focus ring
ARIA roles: list + listitem for the lattice; role=dialog avoided for inline tips
Color contrast: ensure progress halo & badge meet 4.5:1 when conveying state
Alt text provided for every illustration; short descriptive copy for screen readers
acceptance_criteria: Designs exported and uploaded to Drive with approved filenames
Engineering handoff doc created and reviewed by frontend leads
Prototype clickable in Figma across three breakpoints
PM sign-off confirming metrics to track (tile click-through and conversion)
Accessibility checklist passed by accessibility reviewer
qa_checklist: Tiles render correctly at all breakpoints and on retina devices
Tip anchors persist only for first session or until dismissed
Empty-state illustrations compress without jaggies at @1x and @2x
Colors map correctly to CSS tokens in staging build
Motion timings match provided motion spec and do not exceed 300ms
review_feedback: PM (Rafael Ortiz): prefer stronger CTA copy for deploy tile; suggested 'Create first deployment'
Engineering (Liam O'Connor): requested JSON layout hints with absolute pixel fallbacks for older browsers
Accessibility (Nadia Patel): requested keyboard-only flow doc and confirmation that tip dismiss persists server-side for enterprise
Design lead (Olivia Park): asked to reduce visual noise on mobile by collapsing secondary microcopy
decisions: Use lattice (tile grid) instead of modal to reduce cognitive load
Keep tip-anchor lifetime to first successful action or manual dismissal
Deliver both light and dark variants in initial release
Avoid complex SVG filters to keep asset size small (<50KB per SVG)
